verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding agent, so controlling which tools and integrations it may access is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack documents tool-like features (/web scraping, /run, /test, /git) and generic configuration via command-line switches, .aider.conf.yml, or AIDER_xxx environment variables. None of the evidence shows an allowlist, permission policy, or admin control that restricts which external tools or integrations the agent can use; generic configuration is only an adjacent control.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
